verses.original: אַחְאָב֙ וַיַּגֵּ֤ד לְאִיזֶ֔בֶל אֵ֛ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֵלִיָּ֑הוּ וְאֵ֨ת עָשָׂ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָרַ֛ג אֶת־ כָּל־ כָּל־ הַנְּבִיאִ֖ים בֶּחָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḥ·’āḇ way·yag·gêḏ lə·’î·ze·ḇel ’êṯ kāl- ’ă·šer ’ê·lî·yā·hū wə·’êṯ ‘ā·śāh ’ă·šer hā·raḡ ’eṯ- kāl- kāl- han·nə·ḇî·’îm be·ḥā·reḇ
verses.literal: Now Ahab told Jezebel - everything that Elijah - had done and how he had killed - - all the prophets with the sword

verses.original: אִיזֶ֙בֶל֙ וַתִּשְׁלַ֤ח מַלְאָ֔ךְ אֶל־ אֵלִיָּ֖הוּ לֵאמֹ֑ר כֹּֽה־ אֱלֹהִים֙ יַעֲשׂ֤וּן וְכֹ֣ה יוֹסִפ֔וּן כִּֽי־ כָעֵ֤ת מָחָר֙ אָשִׂ֣ים אֶֽת־ נַפְשְׁךָ֔ כְּנֶ֖פֶשׁ אַחַ֥ד מֵהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’î·ze·ḇel wat·tiš·laḥ mal·’āḵ ’el- ’ê·lî·yā·hū lê·mōr kōh- ’ĕ·lō·hîm ya·‘ă·śūn wə·ḵōh yō·w·si·p̄ūn kî- ḵā·‘êṯ mā·ḥār ’ā·śîm ’eṯ- nap̄·šə·ḵā kə·ne·p̄eš ’a·ḥaḏ mê·hem
verses.literal: So Jezebel sent a messenger to Elijah saying May the gods deal with me and ever so severely if by this time tomorrow I have not made - your life like the lives of [those you killed] . . .

verses.original: וַיַּ֗רְא וַיָּ֙קָם֙ וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ אֶל־ נַפְשׁ֔וֹ וַיָּבֹ֕א בְּאֵ֥ר שֶׁ֖בַע אֲשֶׁ֣ר לִֽיהוּדָ֑ה וַיַּנַּ֥ח אֶֽת־ נַעֲר֖וֹ שָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yar way·yā·qām way·yê·leḵ ’el- nap̄·šōw way·yā·ḇō bə·’êr še·ḇa‘ ’ă·šer lî·hū·ḏāh way·yan·naḥ ’eṯ- na·‘ă·rōw šām
verses.literal: And Elijah was afraid . . . and ran for his life When he came vvv to Beersheba - in Judah he left - his servant there

verses.original: וְהֽוּא־ הָלַ֤ךְ י֔וֹם וַיָּבֹ֕א דֶּ֣רֶךְ בַּמִּדְבָּר֙ וַיֵּ֕שֶׁב תַּ֖חַת אֶחָת רֹ֣תֶם וַיִּשְׁאַ֤ל אֶת־ נַפְשׁוֹ֙ לָמ֔וּת רַ֗ב עַתָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר׀ קַ֣ח נַפְשִׁ֔י כִּֽי־ אָנֹכִ֖י לֹא־ ט֥וֹב מֵאֲבֹתָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hū- hā·laḵ yō·wm way·yā·ḇō de·reḵ bam·miḏ·bār way·yê·šeḇ ta·ḥaṯ ʾɛ·ḥå̄ṯ rō·ṯem way·yiš·’al ’eṯ- nap̄·šōw lā·mūṯ raḇ ‘at·tāh Yah·weh way·yō·mer qaḥ nap̄·šî kî- ’ā·nō·ḵî lō- ṭō·wḇ mê·’ă·ḇō·ṯāy
verses.literal: while he himself went a day’s . . . journey into the wilderness He sat down under a broom tree and prayed - that he might die I have had enough . . . LORD he said Take my life for I am no better than my fathers

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁכַּב֙ תַּ֖חַת רֹ֣תֶם וַיִּישַׁ֔ן אֶחָ֑ד וְהִנֵּֽה־ זֶ֤ה מַלְאָךְ֙ נֹגֵ֣עַ בּ֔וֹ וַיֹּ֥אמֶר ל֖וֹ ק֥וּם אֱכֽוֹל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·kaḇ ta·ḥaṯ rō·ṯem way·yî·šan ’e·ḥāḏ wə·hin·nêh- zeh mal·’āḵ nō·ḡê·a‘ bōw way·yō·mer lōw qūm ’ĕ·ḵō·wl
verses.literal: Then he lay down under the broom tree and fell asleep . . . Suddenly . . . an angel touched him and said Get up and eat

verses.original: וַיַּבֵּ֕ט וְהִנֵּ֧ה מְרַאֲשֹׁתָ֛יו עֻגַ֥ת רְצָפִ֖ים וְצַפַּ֣חַת מָ֑יִם וַיֹּ֣אכַל וַיֵּ֔שְׁתְּ וַיִּשְׁכָּֽב׃ וַיָּ֖שָׁב
verses.transliteration: way·yab·bêṭ wə·hin·nêh mə·ra·’ă·šō·ṯāw ‘u·ḡaṯ rə·ṣā·p̄îm wə·ṣap·pa·ḥaṯ mā·yim way·yō·ḵal way·yê·šət way·yiš·kāḇ way·yā·šāḇ
verses.literal: And he looked around and there by his head was a cake of bread baked over hot coals and a jar of water So he ate and drank and lay down again

verses.original: שֵׁנִית֙ מַלְאַ֨ךְ יְהוָ֤ה׀ וַיָּשָׁב֩ וַיִּגַּע־ בּ֔וֹ וַיֹּ֖אמֶר ק֣וּם אֱכֹ֑ל כִּ֛י הַדָּֽרֶךְ׃ רַ֥ב מִמְּךָ֖
verses.transliteration: šê·nîṯ mal·’aḵ Yah·weh way·yā·šāḇ way·yig·ga‘- bōw way·yō·mer qūm ’ĕ·ḵōl kî had·dā·reḵ raḇ mim·mə·ḵā
verses.literal: A second [time] the angel of the LORD returned and touched him saying Get up and eat . . . or the journey will be too much for you

verses.original: וַיָּ֖קָם וַיֹּ֣אכַל וַיִּשְׁתֶּ֑ה בְּכֹ֣חַ׀ הַהִ֗יא הָאֲכִילָ֣ה וַיֵּ֜לֶךְ אַרְבָּעִ֥ים יוֹם֙ וְאַרְבָּעִ֣ים לַ֔יְלָה עַ֛ד חֹרֵֽב׃ הַ֥ר הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qām way·yō·ḵal way·yiš·teh bə·ḵō·aḥ ha·hî hā·’ă·ḵî·lāh way·yê·leḵ ’ar·bā·‘îm yō·wm wə·’ar·bā·‘îm lay·lāh ‘aḏ ḥō·rêḇ har hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: So he got up and ate and drank And strengthened by that food he walked forty days and forty nights until he reached Horeb the mountain of God

verses.original: שָׁ֑ם וְהִנֵּ֤ה וַיָּבֹא־ שָׁ֥ם אֶל־ הַמְּעָרָ֖ה וַיָּ֣לֶן דְבַר־ יְהוָה֙ אֵלָ֔יו וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֔וֹ מַה־ לְּךָ֥ פֹ֖ה אֵלִיָּֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: šām wə·hin·nêh way·yā·ḇō- šām ’el- ham·mə·‘ā·rāh way·yā·len ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’ê·lāw way·yō·mer lōw mah- lə·ḵā p̄ōh ’ê·lî·yā·hū
verses.literal: There . . . [Elijah] entered . . . . . . a cave and spent the night And the word of the LORD came to him saying - What are you doing here Elijah

verses.original: קַנֹּ֨א קִנֵּ֜אתִי לַיהוָ֣ה׀ אֱלֹהֵ֣י צְבָא֗וֹת וַיֹּאמֶר֩ כִּֽי־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶת־ עָזְב֤וּ בְרִֽיתְךָ֙ הָרָ֔סוּ וְאֶת־ מִזְבְּחֹתֶ֣יךָ הָרְג֣וּ נְבִיאֶ֖יךָ בֶחָ֑רֶב אֲנִי֙ לְבַדִּ֔י וָֽאִוָּתֵ֤ר וַיְבַקְשׁ֥וּ אֶת־ לְקַחְתָּֽהּ׃ נַפְשִׁ֖י
verses.transliteration: qan·nō qin·nê·ṯî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ way·yō·mer kî- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- ‘ā·zə·ḇū ḇə·rî·ṯə·ḵā hā·rā·sū wə·’eṯ- miz·bə·ḥō·ṯe·ḵā hā·rə·ḡū nə·ḇî·’e·ḵā ḇe·ḥā·reḇ ’ă·nî lə·ḇad·dî wā·’iw·wā·ṯêr way·ḇaq·šū ’eṯ- lə·qaḥ·tāh nap̄·šî
verses.literal: I have been very zealous . . . for the LORD the God of Hosts he replied but the Israelites . . . - have forsaken Your covenant torn down - Your altars and killed Your prophets with the sword I am the only one left and they are seeking - - my life {as well}

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר צֵ֣א וְעָמַדְתָּ֣ בָהָר֮ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָה֒ וְהִנֵּ֧ה יְהוָ֣ה עֹבֵ֗ר גְּדוֹלָ֡ה וְחָזָ֞ק וְר֣וּחַ מְפָרֵק֩ הָרִ֨ים וּמְשַׁבֵּ֤ר סְלָעִים֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה יְהוָ֑ה לֹ֥א בָר֖וּחַ וְאַחַ֤ר הָר֨וּחַ רַ֔עַשׁ יְהוָֽה׃ לֹ֥א בָרַ֖עַשׁ
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ṣê wə·‘ā·maḏ·tā ḇā·hār lip̄·nê Yah·weh wə·hin·nêh Yah·weh ‘ō·ḇêr gə·ḏō·w·lāh wə·ḥā·zāq wə·rū·aḥ mə·p̄ā·rêq hā·rîm ū·mə·šab·bêr sə·lā·‘îm lip̄·nê Yah·weh Yah·weh lō ḇā·rū·aḥ wə·’a·ḥar hå̄·rū·aḥ ra·‘aš Yah·weh lō ḇā·ra·‘aš
verses.literal: Then [the LORD] said Go out and stand on the mountain before the LORD Behold the LORD is about to pass by And a great and mighty wind tore into the mountains and shattered the rocks before the LORD but the LORD was not in the wind After the wind there was an earthquake but the LORD was not in the earthquake

verses.original: וְאַחַ֤ר הָרַ֙עַשׁ֙ בָאֵ֖שׁ יְהוָ֑ה לֹ֥א אֵ֔שׁ וְאַחַ֣ר הָאֵ֔שׁ דְּמָמָ֥ה דַקָּֽה׃ ק֖וֹל
verses.transliteration: wə·’a·ḥar hā·ra·‘aš ḇā·’êš Yah·weh lō ’êš wə·’a·ḥar hā·’êš də·mā·māh ḏaq·qāh qō·wl
verses.literal: After the earthquake there was a fire but the LORD was not in the fire And after the fire came a still small voice

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י׀ אֵלִיָּ֗הוּ כִּשְׁמֹ֣עַ וַיָּ֤לֶט פָּנָיו֙ בְּאַדַּרְתּ֔וֹ וַיֵּצֵ֕א וַֽיַּעֲמֹ֖ד פֶּ֣תַח הַמְּעָרָ֑ה וְהִנֵּ֤ה ק֔וֹל אֵלָיו֙ וַיֹּ֕אמֶר מַה־ לְּךָ֥ פֹ֖ה אֵלִיָּֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ’ê·lî·yā·hū kiš·mō·a‘ way·yā·leṭ pā·nāw bə·’ad·dar·tōw way·yê·ṣê way·ya·‘ă·mōḏ pe·ṯaḥ ham·mə·‘ā·rāh wə·hin·nêh qō·wl ’ê·lāw way·yō·mer mah- lə·ḵā p̄ōh ’ê·lî·yā·hū
verses.literal: - When Elijah heard it he wrapped his face in his cloak and went out and stood at the mouth of the cave Suddenly a voice [came] to him and said What are you doing here Elijah

verses.original: קַנֹּ֨א קִנֵּ֜אתִי לַיהוָ֣ה׀ אֱלֹהֵ֣י צְבָא֗וֹת וַיֹּאמֶר֩ כִּֽי־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶת־ עָזְב֤וּ בְרִֽיתְךָ֙ הָרָ֔סוּ וְאֶת־ מִזְבְּחֹתֶ֣יךָ הָרְג֣וּ נְבִיאֶ֖יךָ בֶחָ֑רֶב אֲנִי֙ לְבַדִּ֔י וָאִוָּתֵ֤ר וַיְבַקְשׁ֥וּ אֶת־ לְקַחְתָּֽהּ׃ס נַפְשִׁ֖י
verses.transliteration: qan·nō qin·nê·ṯî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ way·yō·mer kî- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- ‘ā·zə·ḇū ḇə·rî·ṯə·ḵā hā·rā·sū wə·’eṯ- miz·bə·ḥō·ṯe·ḵā hā·rə·ḡū nə·ḇî·’e·ḵā ḇe·ḥā·reḇ ’ă·nî lə·ḇad·dî wā·’iw·wā·ṯêr way·ḇaq·šū ’eṯ- lə·qaḥ·tāh nap̄·šî
verses.literal: I have been very zealous . . . for the LORD the God of Hosts he replied but the Israelites . . . - have forsaken Your covenant torn down - Your altars and killed Your prophets with the sword I am the only one left and they are seeking - - my life {as well}

verses.original: יְהוָה֙ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָ֔יו לֵ֛ךְ שׁ֥וּב לְדַרְכְּךָ֖ מִדְבַּ֣רָה דַמָּ֑שֶׂק וּבָ֗אתָ וּמָשַׁחְתָּ֧ אֶת־ חֲזָאֵ֛ל לְמֶ֖לֶךְ עַל־ אֲרָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw lêḵ šūḇ lə·ḏar·kə·ḵā miḏ·ba·rāh ḏam·må̄·śɛq ū·ḇā·ṯā ū·mā·šaḥ·tā ’eṯ- ḥă·zā·’êl lə·me·leḵ ‘al- ’ă·rām
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to him Go back by the way you came [and go] to the Desert of Damascus When you arrive you are to anoint - Hazael as king over Aram

verses.original: וְאֵת֙ תִּמְשַׁ֥ח יֵה֣וּא בֶן־ נִמְשִׁ֔י לְמֶ֖לֶךְ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְאֶת־ אֱלִישָׁ֤ע בֶּן־ שָׁפָט֙ מֵאָבֵ֣ל מְחוֹלָ֔ה תִּמְשַׁ֥ח תַּחְתֶּֽיךָ׃ לְנָבִ֖יא
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ tim·šaḥ yê·hū ḇen- nim·šî lə·me·leḵ ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl wə·’eṯ- ’ĕ·lî·šā‘ ben- šā·p̄āṭ mê·’ā·ḇêl mə·ḥō·w·lāh tim·šaḥ taḥ·te·ḵā lə·nā·ḇî
verses.literal: vvv You are also to anoint Jehu son of Nimshi as king over Israel - and Elisha son of Shaphat vvv from Abel-meholah . . . to succeed you as prophet

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה יֵה֑וּא יָמִ֣ית הַנִּמְלָ֛ט מֵחֶ֥רֶב חֲזָאֵ֖ל אֱלִישָֽׁע׃ יָמִ֥ית וְהַנִּמְלָ֛ט מֵחֶ֥רֶב יֵה֖וּא
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh yê·hū yā·mîṯ han·nim·lāṭ mê·ḥe·reḇ ḥă·zā·’êl ’ĕ·lî·šā‘ yā·mîṯ wə·han·nim·lāṭ mê·ḥe·reḇ yê·hū
verses.literal: Then Jehu will put to death whoever escapes the sword of Hazael and Elisha will put to death whoever escapes the sword of Jehu

verses.original: וְהִשְׁאַרְתִּ֥י שִׁבְעַ֣ת אֲלָפִ֑ים בְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֤ר הַבִּרְכַּ֗יִם לֹֽא־ כָֽרְעוּ֙ לַבַּ֔עַל וְכָ֨ל־ הַפֶּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־ נָשַׁ֖ק לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiš·’ar·tî šiḇ·‘aṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm ḇə·yiś·rā·’êl kāl- ’ă·šer hab·bir·ka·yim lō- ḵā·rə·‘ū lab·ba·‘al wə·ḵāl hap·peh ’ă·šer lō- nā·šaq lōw
verses.literal: Nevertheless, I have reserved seven thousand in Israel all whose knees have not bowed to Baal and [whose] mouths - have not kissed him

verses.original: וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ מִ֠שָּׁם וַיִּמְצָ֞א אֶת־ אֱלִישָׁ֤ע בֶּן־ שָׁפָט֙ וְה֣וּא חֹרֵ֔שׁ שְׁנֵים־ עָשָׂ֤ר צְמָדִים֙ לְפָנָ֔יו וְה֖וּא בִּשְׁנֵ֣ים הֶעָשָׂ֑ר אֵלִיָּ֙הוּ֙ וַיַּעֲבֹ֤ר אֵלָ֔יו וַיַּשְׁלֵ֥ךְ אַדַּרְתּ֖וֹ אֵלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ miš·šām way·yim·ṣā ’eṯ- ’ĕ·lî·šā‘ ben- šā·p̄āṭ wə·hū ḥō·rêš šə·nêm- ‘ā·śār ṣə·mā·ḏîm lə·p̄ā·nāw wə·hū biš·nêm he·‘ā·śār ’ê·lî·yā·hū way·ya·‘ă·ḇōr ’ê·lāw way·yaš·lêḵ ’ad·dar·tōw ’ê·lāw
verses.literal: So Elijah departed . . . and found - Elisha son of Shaphat He was plowing with twelve . . . teams [of oxen] and he was with the twelfth [team] . . . Elijah passed by him and threw his cloak around him

verses.original: וַיַּעֲזֹ֣ב אֶת־ הַבָּקָ֗ר וַיָּ֙רָץ֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י אֵֽלִיָּ֔הוּ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר נָּא֙ אֶשְּׁקָה־ לְאָבִ֣י וּלְאִמִּ֔י וְאֵלְכָ֖ה אַחֲרֶ֑יךָ לֵ֣ךְ שׁ֔וּב וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לוֹ֙ כִּ֥י מֶה־ עָשִׂ֖יתִי לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·zōḇ ’eṯ- hab·bā·qār way·yā·rāṣ ’a·ḥă·rê ’ê·lî·yā·hū way·yō·mer nā ’eš·šə·qāh- lə·’ā·ḇî ū·lə·’im·mî wə·’ê·lə·ḵāh ’a·ḥă·re·ḵā lêḵ šūḇ way·yō·mer lōw kî meh- ‘ā·śî·ṯî lāḵ
verses.literal: So Elisha left - the oxen ran after Elijah and said Please let me kiss my father and mother [goodbye] and then I will follow you Go on back [Elijah] replied for what have I done to you

verses.original: וַיָּ֨שָׁב מֵאַחֲרָ֜יו וַיִּקַּ֣ח אֶת־ צֶ֧מֶד הַבָּקָ֣ר וַיִּזְבָּחֵ֗הוּ הַבָּקָר֙ וּבִכְלִ֤י בִּשְּׁלָ֣ם הַבָּשָׂ֔ר וַיִּתֵּ֥ן לָעָ֖ם וַיֹּאכֵ֑לוּ וַיָּ֗קָם וַיֵּ֛לֶךְ אַחֲרֵ֥י וַיְשָׁרְתֵֽהוּ׃פ אֵלִיָּ֖הוּ
verses.transliteration: way·yā·šāḇ mê·’a·ḥă·rāw way·yiq·qaḥ ’eṯ- ṣe·meḏ hab·bā·qār way·yiz·bā·ḥê·hū hab·bā·qār ū·ḇiḵ·lî biš·šə·lām hab·bā·śār way·yit·tên lā·‘ām way·yō·ḵê·lū way·yā·qām way·yê·leḵ ’a·ḥă·rê way·šā·rə·ṯê·hū ’ê·lî·yā·hū
verses.literal: So [Elisha] turned back from him took - his pair of oxen and slaughtered them Using the oxen’s equipment [for fuel] he cooked the meat and gave it to the people and they ate Then he set out to follow . . . and serve Elijah
